name: armorpaint
readme_excerpt: armorpaint ArmorPaint is a software for 3D PBR texture painting - check out the manual. Note 1: This repository is aimed at developers and may not be stable. Distributed binaries are paid to help with the project funding. All of the development is happening here in order to make it accessible to everyone. Thank you for support!
